Statistics: Total number of not blank m/zs
Description: Total number of not blank m/zs in the final table (BLANKS_TOTAL == 0).

Statistics: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs
Description: Total number of not bed (not culture media) m/zs over the not blank m/zs, BEDS_TOTAL == 0.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in UNPD or GNPS final curated and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the UNPD and GNPS libraries - final curated library annotation (curated_lib_annotation_origin not empty). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in UNPD as final curated library annotation and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the UNPD and selected as origin in the final curated library annotation (curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'UNPD'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in GNPS as final curated library annotation and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the GNPS and selected as origin in the final curated library annotation (curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'GNPS'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique UNPD or GNPS final curated library annotations and their UNPD and GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique UNPD and GNPS annotations that passed the final library annotation curation (unique curated_lib_annotation_SMILES with curated_lib_annotation_SMILES not empty) - unique identified molecules and their percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 plus UNPD (90253+183962 compounds for GNPS and UNPD total unique SMILES) - the final origin GNPS and UNPD coverage by [M+H]+.

Statistics: Number of unique UNPD origin from the final curated library annotations and its UNPD coverage
Description: Total number of unique UNPD library annotations selected as origin in the final library annotation curation (unique curated_lib_annotation_SMILES with curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'UNPD') - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in UNPD (183962 compounds for UNPD total unique SMILES) - the UNPD coverage.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS origin from the final curated library annotations and its GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS library annotations selected as origin in the final library annotation curation (unique curated_lib_annotation_SMILES with curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'GNPS') - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in GNPS all and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of all not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the GNPS libraries (gnps_SpectrumID is not NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS library annotations from all and its GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS library annotations from not blank and not bed m/zs among all results (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA) - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.

Statistics: Number of m/zs identified in UNPD all and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of all not blank and not bed m/zs that were identified against the UNPD using tremolo (tremolo_SMILES_best != NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique UNPD library annotations from all and its UNPD coverage
Description: Total number of unique UNPD library annotations from not blank and not bed m/zs among all results (unique tremolo_SMILES_best that are not NA) - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in UNPD (183962 compounds for UNPD total unique SMILES) - the UNPD coverage.

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed m/zs that were selected as [M+H]+ (protonated_representative == 1) - putative molecules. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed m/zs.

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in UNPD or GNPS final curated
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the UNPD or GNPS and passed the final library annotation curation (curated_lib_annotation_origin not empty). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in UNPD as final curated library annotation
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the UNPD and selected as origin in the final library annotation curation (curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'UNPD'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in GNPS as final curated library annotation
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the GNPS and selected as origin in the final library annotation curation (curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'GNPS'). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of putative novel [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS and UNPD curated
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were NOT identified against the UNPD or the GNPS libraries (curated_lib_annotation_origin == ''), thus, may represent putative novel compounds not present in the databases. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of unique final curated library annotations of the [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS and their coverage
Description: The number of unique and final curated library annotations in GNPS selected as the final origin for the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (unique curated_lib_annotation_SMILES for curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'GNPS' over 90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the final curated GNPS coverage by [M+H]+.

Statistics: Number of unique final curated library annotations of the [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD and their coverage
Description: The number of unique and final curated library annotations in UNPD selected as the final origin for the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in UNPD (unique curated_lib_annotation_SMILES for curated_lib_annotation_origin == 'UNPD' over 183962 compounds for UNPD total unique SMILES) - the final curated UNPD coverage by [M+H]+.

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS and UNPD Superclasses final curated
Description: The unique number of superclasses that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS or UNPD after the final curated library annotation. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses considered (94 for NPClassifier).

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS and UNPD Superclasses grouping final curated
Description: The unique number of superclasses grouping that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD or GNPS libraries (unique curated_lib_annotation_superclass_grouping != Not_Annotated). And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses grouping considered (10 groups proposed by NP3 from the NPClassifier superclasses without the not annotated ones).

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in GNPS all and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of all not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the GNPS libraries (gnps_SpectrumID is not NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of putative novel [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS all
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were NOT identified against the GNPS (gnps_SpectrumID is NA), thus, may represent putative novel compounds not present in the database. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs - the spectral identification rate.

Statistics: Number of unique GNPS library annotations in all of the [M+H]+ m/zs and GNPS coverage
Description: Total number of unique GNPS library annotations from all not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA) - unique identified molecules and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in GNPS from April 2026 (unique gnps_Smiles that are not NA over 90253 compounds for GNPS total unique SMILES) - the GNPS coverage.

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses curated
Description: The unique number of superclasses that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses considered (94 for GNPS using NPClassifier).

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ in GNPS Superclasses curated grouping
Description: The unique number of superclasses grouping that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in GNPS. And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses grouping considered (10 groups proposed by NP3 from the NPClassifier superclasses without the not annotated ones).

Statistics: Number of [M+H]+ m/zs identified in UNPD best and spectral identification rate
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were identified against the UNPD using tremolo and selected as best result (tremolo_best_position != NA). And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of putative novel [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD best
Description: Total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs that were NOT identified against the UNPD using tremolo best result (tremolo_best_position == NA), thus, may represent putative novel compounds not present in the database. And its percentage over the total number of not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs.

Statistics: Number of unique UNPD best library annotations for the [M+H]+ m/zs and their UNPD coverage
Description: The number of unique best library annotations in UNPD for the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs (unique tremolo_SMILES_best for tremolo_best_position != NA ) and its percentage over the total number of unique SMILES in UNPD (183962 compounds for UNPD total unique SMILES) - the UNPD coverage by [M+H]+.

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD Superclasses best
Description: The unique number of best superclasses that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD (column tremolo_NPClassifier_superclass_clean_best not NA or empty). And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses considered (94 for UNPD using NPClassifier).

Statistics: Chemical diversity of [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD Superclasses best grouping
Description: The unique number of best superclasses grouping that got identified by the not blank and not bed [M+H]+ m/zs in UNPD (column tremolo_NPClassifier_superclass_grouping_best not NA or empty). And its percentage over the total number of unique superclasses grouping considered (10 groups proposed by NP3 from the NPClassifier superclasses).
